sentences.en: London air was not much to boast of at best.
sentences.zh: 在最好的情况下，伦敦的空气质量也不值得夸耀。

sentences.en: Bill boasts of owning the biggest car in the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 比尔吹嘘自己拥有小区里最大的车。

sentences.en: The architect boasted that he had received a prestigious award.
sentences.zh: 这位建筑师自夸说他获得了重要奖项。

mnemonic: 联想记忆：烤鸭（roast duck）值得夸耀（boast）
